# Biological physics

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_prompts.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. Paths are relative to this folder; the index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| Id | Card | Applies when |
|---|---|---|
| T-BIOMOLECULAR-NMR | [Biomolecular NMR](biomolecular-nmr.md) | the paper uses solution or solid-state NMR of proteins or nucleic acids to report resonance assignments, a structure calculated from NMR restraints, relaxation or exchange dynamics, or binding sites and affinities from chemical-shift perturbation |
| T-CELL-MECHANICS | [Cell mechanics](cell-mechanics.md) | the paper reports a Young's modulus, stiffness, viscoelastic parameter, cortical tension or traction force of cells or soft tissue from atomic force microscope indentation, micropipette aspiration, traction force microscopy or a similar method, or compares cells by such values |
| CL-QUANTUM-BIOLOGY | [Claims of quantum effects in biology](quantum-biology.md) | the paper claims that quantum coherence, tunnelling, entanglement or electron or nuclear spin dynamics play a functional role in a biological process such as photosynthetic energy transfer, enzyme catalysis, magnetoreception or olfaction, or infers such a role from spectroscopic, isotope or magnetic-field data |
| T-CRYO-EM | [Cryo-electron microscopy](cryo-em.md) | the paper reports a three-dimensional map from single-particle cryo-electron microscopy, cryo-electron tomography or subtomogram averaging, quotes a resolution from a Fourier shell correlation, or builds an atomic model into such a map |
| T-FLUORESCENCE-CORRELATION | [Fluorescence correlation spectroscopy and diffusion](fluorescence-correlation.md) | the paper reports diffusion coefficients, mobilities, concentrations or binding from fluorescence correlation or cross-correlation spectroscopy or fluorescence recovery after photobleaching, or attributes slow or anomalous diffusion in cells to binding or crowding; single-particle tracking has its own card |
| T-MACROMOLECULAR-CRYSTALLOGRAPHY | [Macromolecular crystallography](macromolecular-crystallography.md) | the paper reports an X-ray or neutron crystal structure of a protein, nucleic acid or complex, or bases a claim about a binding mode, a bound ligand or metal, an active-site chemistry, a protonation state or a conformational change on such a structure |
| T-ELECTROPHYSIOLOGY | [Membranes and electrophysiology](electrophysiology.md) | the paper reports patch-clamp, whole-cell, planar lipid bilayer or other electrical recordings from cells, membranes or ion channels, or bases a claim about channel gating, conductance, selectivity, pharmacology, single-channel events or the identity of a channel on them |
| T-MOLECULAR-DYNAMICS-EVIDENCE | [Molecular dynamics as evidence](molecular-dynamics-evidence.md) | the paper uses molecular dynamics, enhanced sampling or related biomolecular simulations to support a mechanism, a conformational change, a binding mode, a free energy, a pathway or the interpretation of an experiment |
| T-MOLECULAR-MOTORS | [Molecular motors and step detection](molecular-motors.md) | the paper tracks single motor proteins or other molecular machines with optical or magnetic tweezers, bead or fluorescence tracking, and bases a claim about step size, substeps, dwell times, velocity, stall force, ATP or load dependence, or stepping mechanism on the traces |
| T-NEURAL-IMAGING | [Optical recording of neural activity](neural-imaging.md) | the paper records neural activity by calcium or voltage imaging with genetically encoded or synthetic indicators, and bases a claim on fluorescence changes, inferred spikes or events, response properties, correlations between cells, or the activity of identified cells or cell types |
| T-SINGLE-MOLECULE-FLUORESCENCE | [Single-molecule fluorescence and FRET](single-molecule-fluorescence.md) | the paper reports single-molecule fluorescence or single-molecule FRET data, from surface-immobilized molecules or freely diffusing bursts, and bases a claim on FRET efficiencies, inter-dye distances, conformational states, state populations, transition rates or binding events inferred from them |
| T-FORCE-SPECTROSCOPY | [Single-molecule force spectroscopy](force-spectroscopy.md) | the paper pulls on single molecules or molecular complexes with optical tweezers, magnetic tweezers or an atomic force microscope, or bases a claim about unfolding, rupture or stall forces, bond lifetimes, kinetic rates, transition-state distances or energy landscapes on force-extension or force-time traces |
| T-SUPER-RESOLUTION-MICROSCOPY | [Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy](super-resolution-microscopy.md) | the paper uses single-molecule localization microscopy (PALM, STORM, DNA-PAINT), STED, structured illumination or expansion microscopy, or bases a claim about nanoscale structure, distances, molecular counts, clustering or resolution on super-resolved fluorescence images |
